title: Senior Product Designer, Cross Activation
descriptionHtml:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at Superhuman and about our values here.

 

The Opportunity

As Superhuman brings together Grammarly, Superhuman Docs, and Mail into a unified AI productivity suite, Growth Design plays an increasingly important role in helping customers discover, adopt, and engage with our broader ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape how users find value across multiple products, discover new workflows, and build lasting habits throughout their customer journey.

As a Senior Product Designer, Growth, you will design and execute activation, onboarding, and early lifecycle experiences across the Superhuman suite. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Research, and Analytics to craft thoughtful experiments, define key moments of customer value, and create polished product experiences that drive adoption and engagement.

This is a highly collaborative role that calls for strong product intuition, exceptional craft, and a data-informed approach to design. You will help shape cross-product discovery experiences, explore how AI-powered capabilities can be introduced in meaningful ways, and contribute to a culture of experimentation that helps more customers realize the value of Superhuman.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Design impactful onboarding, activation, upgrade, and early-lifecycle experiences that help users discover features, build habits, and realize value across the Superhuman suite.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Research, and Analytics to identify growth opportunities and deliver customer-centric solutions that drive adoption, engagement, and upgrades.

  • Define and execute growth experiments that guide users toward meaningful “aha” moments, from developing hypotheses and early concepts to interactive prototypes and polished, high-fidelity designs.

  • Use qualitative and quantitative customer insights to improve feature discovery, habit formation, and early value realization, driving meaningful adoption across products.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers to shape the vision and roadmap for cross-product activation initiatives, creating cohesive experiences that help users discover and engage with Grammarly, Superhuman Docs, and Mail as a unified suite.

  • Engage stakeholders to align on onboarding, upgrade, and team growth journeys, communicating design concepts and progress to leadership to gather feedback and build alignment.

  • Create interaction patterns that balance power, simplicity, and approachability across complex workflows, advising Product and Engineering partners to resolve design challenges and accelerate delivery.

  • Collaborate with designers and product teams across Grammarly, Mail, and Coda to identify cross-product discovery opportunities, foster shared learning, and develop cohesive experiences across the suite.

  • Deliver polished, on-brand designs that balance user needs with business goals, using experimentation and emerging AI tools and workflows to improve design processes and drive measurable impact.

  • Contribute to a high-bar design culture through thoughtful critique, mentorship, and collaboration, continuously elevating design craft, quality, and brand standards across the team.

 

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, with at least 3+ years focused on growth, onboarding, activation, engagement, or lifecycle experiences. Experience with monetization and upgrade flows is a plus.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across interaction design, visual design, prototyping, typography, layout, and systems thinking.

  • Experience designing and running product experiments that balance customer needs with business goals and measurable outcomes.

  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Research, and Analytics teams.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale, strategy, and tradeoffs.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, bring clarity to complex problems, and adapt quickly as new insights emerge.

  • Deep empathy for users and a strong understanding of customer behavior, motivation, and emotional experience.

  • Self-directed and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and move quickly in fast-paced environments.

  • Enthusiasm for AI-native products and workflows, with curiosity about how AI can improve both customer experiences and team productivity.

 

Compensation and Benefits

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

  • Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)

  • Disability and life insurance options

  • 401(k) and RRSP matching

  • Paid parental leave

  • 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time

  • Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more)

  • Annual professional development budget and opportunities

Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, which means base pay may vary depending on your location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations. In Canada, all locations where we support employment are considered “Zone 1”.

For more information about our compensation zones and locations where we currently support employment, please refer to this page. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information.

Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future.

 

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).
